notes.title: XVTM Midsummer Status Update
notes.content:
Happy summer, arcology citizens!

 

With the second half of the year now underway, I wanted to provide an update on the current state of development, along with how things are looking for an end of year 1.0 release. Here are the highlights:

Index 3, the next (and final) release for Early Access, is about 50% complete.

The second half of Index 3, including XVTM’s finale and unique epilogues for each story path, is now in development.

Confidence remains high for a full 1.0 release before the end of 2025.

XVTM is participating in Steam’s Summer Sale, so if you have friends with tastes as strange as yours, please be sure to recommend it to them.

 [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2803990/XVTM/"][/dynamiclink]

Thank you for your support, enjoy the sun, and stay tuned for more updates later in the year.

 

-LCN

notes.title: Index 2 Now Available
notes.content:
Hello, arcology citizens!

The next major content update, Index 2, is now available. This update represents the next 35% of XVTM, and picks up where the previous release, Index 1, left off.

It adds a further five and a half hours of playable content per storyline path, several new achievements, and includes numerous bug fixes and tweaks to existing content.

Whether you’re a new player or are coming from the previous release, please be sure to read through the stickied forum posts for extra information before jumping in:

 Frequently Asked Questions About the Game
 Frequently Asked Questions About Early Access
 Known Issues in the Current Build (v0.66.01)
As always, thank you for your support, and feel free to post on the forums if you have any questions, run into issues, or have feedback you’d like to share.

-LCN

notes.title: Progress Update and New Trailer for Index 2
notes.content:
Hello, arcology citizens!

I am pleased to report that the next major content update, Index 2, is almost complete and should be released within a few weeks.

In the meantime, a new trailer has been prepared that shows off some of the new locations, activities, and characters waiting for you in the next update.

You can view the new trailer on the XVTM Store Page here on Steam.

Thank you for your continued support, and keep your eyes on the store page for further updates.

-LCN

notes.title: XVTM End of Year Status Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871600/983f904e008968a627158a4c481fa28754d391a3.png

Merry Christmas, arcology citizens!

As we come to the end of 2024, I wanted to provide an update on XVTM’s development since the start of Early Access back in October. Here are the highlights:


 Index 2, the next major release for Early Access, is around 40% complete.
(The images used in this update are sneak previews from it, too. 😊)
 The first destination in Index 2 is a big one, and entered its ‘content complete’ state in late November.
(Scale-wise, it’s comparable to about half of all of the content in the current Early Access build!)
 The other destinations are under construction right now, absent occasional breaks to try to put a dent in my backlog on Steam.


Thanks for reading, happy holidays, and stay tuned for more updates in the new year.

-LCN

notes.title: XVTM is now available in Early Access!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871600/a28800c5e306af641f0f5d4563bdd1b7bd8aed95.png
Good morning arcology citizens, and welcome to the start of Early Access for XVTM!

This initial release, version 0.33.01, is now live and contains about the first 35% of the total game. In addition, several quality of life improvements have been added if you’re coming from the demo, including:


 Achievements
 Improved text readability
 Autosave and Cloud Save
 Optimized on-disk size

Be sure to look through the Early Access Questions and Answers on the XVTM Store Page, as well as the stickied Early Access FAQ thread in the XVTM Discussion Forums for more information.

Thanks, and please enjoy your time in 2989!

-LCN
